summary: Retest of the sign-out routing fix (frontend only). SIGN-OUT FIX: VERIFIED - the /sign-in dedicated route + pure-dispatcher index.tsx works. Two full sign-in/sign-out cycles completed with ZERO 'Maximum update depth exceeded' console errors, AuthScreen ('Welcome back') renders IMMEDIATELY after tapping logout-button, page stays fully responsive, no blank screen, no reload. Cold load signed-out lands on /sign-in. Deep-link /profile while signed out redirects to /sign-in with no crash. HOWEVER, the restructure introduced a NEW CRITICAL REGRESSION: after a successful sign-in (POST /api/auth/login returns 200, token stored, user set) the app STAYS on /sign-in - no navigation to the Home tab. Root cause: app/sign-in.tsx renders AuthScreen directly and AuthScreen has no 'if (user) return <Redirect href="/(tabs)" />' guard; previously AuthScreen was rendered inline by app/index.tsx, whose own redirect handled post-login navigation. Sign-in only lands on Home after a manual reload/navigation to '/'.

ui_bugs.issue: NEW CRITICAL REGRESSION from the routing restructure: successful sign-in does NOT navigate to Home. critical_code_review_comments: The dispatcher pattern (index.tsx) + unique /sign-in route + tabs guard -> /sign-in is structurally correct and eliminated the '/' ambiguity that caused the iteration_2 render loop.

The restructure missed the inverse transition: /sign-in is now a dead-end once user != null. Both route guards must be symmetric: tabs guard sends !user to /sign-in; sign-in route must send user to /(tabs).
Backend untouched and still healthy: POST /api/auth/login verified 200 with correct user payload via curl during this iteration.

rca_of_issue: REGRESSION: sign-in does not navigate to Home. Repro: open /sign-in, enter trainee.test@skillalign.in / Trainee@Test2026, tap 'Continue securely' (login-submit-button). Observed: POST /api/auth/login 200, token stored, but URL stays /sign-in and the auth form remains; no console error. Root cause: in the old structure AuthScreen was rendered inline by app/index.tsx, so setUser() re-rendered index.tsx which returned <Redirect href='/(tabs)' />. After the restructure, app/sign-in.tsx exports AuthScreen directly and AuthScreen never reads `user` from useAuth, so no component issues a redirect when the session is established. Mitigation: add `if (user) return <Redirect href="/(tabs)" />` to the /sign-in route component (sign-in.tsx) or to AuthScreen. SIGN-OUT (the retest target): FIXED - tabs layout Redirect to the unique /sign-in path no longer loops; verified 2 full cycles with zero 'Maximum update depth exceeded' errors.
